title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware | Antique Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware for space-saving organization in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. Part of the Carolina Collection, this shelf pairs transitional bathroom hardware styling with practical vertical storage.

Highlights:
- Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Thick, beveled-edge glass for a clean, finished look
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a streamlined appearance
- Coordinates with other pieces in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5.54 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
